mapper.sql: select customer_id, customer_no, customer_name, short_name, industry, customer_level, customer_tags, region, company_address, status, customer_source, sales_user_name, business_license_no, business_license_url, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_dept, contact_title, contact_email, contact_wechat, settle_type, credit_limit, pay_period_days, invoice_title, tax_no, bank_name, bank_account_name, bank_account_no, remark, create_by, create_time from tms_customer

mapper.update:
update tms_customer
customer_name = #{customerName}, short_name = #{shortName}, industry = #{industry}, customer_level = #{customerLevel}, customer_tags = #{customerTags}, region = #{region}, company_address = #{companyAddress}, status = #{status}, customer_source = #{customerSource}, sales_user_name = #{salesUserName}, business_license_no = #{businessLicenseNo}, business_license_url = #{businessLicenseUrl}, contact_name = #{contactName}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, contact_dept = #{contactDept}, contact_title = #{contactTitle}, contact_email = #{contactEmail}, contact_wechat = #{contactWechat}, settle_type = #{settleType}, credit_limit = #{creditLimit}, pay_period_days = #{payPeriodDays}, invoice_title = #{invoiceTitle}, tax_no = #{taxNo}, bank_name = #{bankName}, bank_account_name = #{bankAccountName}, bank_account_no = #{bankAccountNo}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate()
